A copper alloy Roman brooch, probably an Aucissa type. The bow has a raised rib along the centre, making it triangular in section and is otherwise undecorated. It terminates in a globular foot. The wings, catch plate and pin are all mostly missing; and the bow has been bent in antiquity. The head of the brooch appears always to have been flat, probably with a small rolled area to hold the axis…
